variants.name: 列で数える・列の番号で並べる

count: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM members WHERE status = '在籍'
group: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE status = '在籍' GROUP BY city ORDER BY 2 DESC

variants.name: 小文字で書く・上の 2 つだけを出す

count: select count(*) from members where status='在籍';
group: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members WHERE status = '在籍' GROUP BY city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2;
second: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members WHERE status = '在籍' GROUP BY city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2;

wrong.why: 在籍で絞らずに数える
